raw_snippet: Today we’re announcing that The OpenAI Deployment Company has agreed to acquire Northslope, an applied AI company that helps enterprises realize the full value of AI across their most important operations.
value_text: agreed to acquire Northslope (Deployment / FDE / implementation services)
note: OpenAI -> Northslope (applied AI firm deploying AI in enterprises); sublayer deployment_services; acquisition; bought by The OpenAI Deployment Company, which OpenAI majority-owns and controls. Ledger sweep of 23 Sep 2026.
